items.exampleEn: Thousands of fans awaited the singer at the airport.
items.exampleZh: 數千名粉絲在機場等候那位歌手。

items.exampleEn: A short walk can relieve stress after work.
items.exampleZh: 下班後散個步可以紓解壓力。

items.exampleEn: The meeting will resume after a short break.
items.exampleZh: 會議短暫休息後會繼續進行。

items.exampleEn: My uncle is a stamp collector.
Smoking is prohibited in all parts of the building.
The company will equip every new worker with a laptop.
items.exampleZh: 公司會給每位新進員工配備一台筆電。

items.exampleEn: Please put your bags on the rack above your seat.
items.exampleZh: 請把你的包包放在座位上方的行李架上。

items.exampleEn: She actively takes part in team discussions.

items.sentenceEn: Bikes must be left on the rack outside, not in the lobby.
items.sentenceZh: 腳踏車必須停在外面的車架上，不能放在大廳。

items.audioEn: The train will resume service in about twenty minutes. Thank you for your patience.
items.audioZh: 火車大約二十分鐘後會恢復行駛。感謝您的耐心等候。

items.sentenceEn: Our team is actively looking for new ways to save energy.
items.sentenceZh: 我們團隊正積極尋找節省能源的新方法。

items.sentenceEn: All the meeting rooms are equipped with large screens.
items.sentenceZh: 所有會議室都配備了大螢幕。

items.stemEn: The company hired two extra workers to ____ the pressure on our busy team.
items.stemZh: 公司多請了兩名員工，來減輕我們這個忙碌團隊的壓力。

items.stemEn: Visitors are ____ from taking photos inside the museum.
items.stemZh: 參觀者在博物館內禁止拍照。

items.passageEn: Mr. Ho is a collector of old cameras. For years, he has actively searched for rare models at markets around the world. Last month, a museum invited him to show his collection. The museum equipped a special room with glass cases and wooden racks, and visitors were prohibited from touching anything. On the opening day, a fire alarm went off, and everyone had to leave the building. It was only a test, which greatly relieved Mr. Ho, since a fire could have been very costly. After an hour, the show resumed. Now he is awaiting news about whether the show can travel to other cities.
items.passageZh: 何先生是老相機收藏家。多年來，他積極地在世界各地的市集尋找稀有機型。上個月，一間博物館邀請他展出收藏。博物館為此佈置了一間特別的展廳，配備玻璃展示櫃和木製架子，參觀者不准觸碰任何東西。開幕當天，火災警報響了，所有人都得離開大樓。結果那只是一次測試，讓何先生大大鬆了一口氣，因為一場火災的代價可能非常高。一小時後，展覽恢復開放。現在他正在等候消息，看展覽能不能到其他城市巡迴。

questions.questionZh: 開幕當天發生了什麼事？
options: 何先生遲到了快要一個小時
有一部相機被偷了，警察趕到現場
博物館停電了，展覽暫停一天
火災警報響，大家得離開

questions.questionZh: 何先生現在在等什麼消息？
options: 博物館要不要買下他全部的相機
展覽能不能到其他城市展出

items.promptZh: 我們正在等候經理的決定。
referenceEn: We are awaiting the manager's decision.
We are awaiting a decision from the manager.
rubricZh: await 後面直接接等待的事物，不加 for（例如 await the decision）；寫 wait for 意思也對
「正在等候」可用現在進行式（例如 are awaiting），寫 await 的現在式也可以

items.promptZh: 這座城市的新規定禁止商店提供免費的塑膠袋。
referenceEn: A new rule in this city prohibits shops from giving out free plastic bags.
The city's new rule prohibits stores from offering free plastic bags.
rubricZh: prohibit 常用 prohibit…from＋動名詞（例如 prohibits shops from giving… 等）；寫成被動也正確
「提供」可寫，例如 give out、offer、provide 等
